Regional Council Approves New Transit Line

By Priya Natarajan — 2 hours ago

The regional council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to approve funding for the long-discussed Riverside Transit extension, a 14-kilometer light rail line connecting the eastern suburbs to the downtown core.

Construction is expected to begin in early 2025, with the first phase — a 6-kilometer segment through Millbrook and Ashford — slated for completion within three years. Total project cost is estimated at $412,000,000, funded jointly by the regional government and a federal infrastructure grant.

“This has been twenty years in the making,” said council member Delia Ochoa. “Riverside residents have waited long enough.”

Opponents of the plan cite cost overruns on similar projects in neighboring districts, where a comparable line came in 38% over its original budget.

The council's next public session is scheduled for 12 June 2024, when a revised construction timeline will be presented.
